recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-8056.
issue_request: FHIR-8056 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 technical correction for the FHIR-core references page: the bundle example used item where Bundle syntax should use entry, and the reporter also noted no entry.link[self] example.
initial_application: Historical commit 426aef96a7b141fed925adb15c6f4849b58044d2, '#8056 - typo in bundle', changed source/references.html from item elements to entry elements wrapping resource elements. The Jira comment says the typo was fixed and entry[self] handling was deferred to a search example.
additional_context: Commit 5544902951a4fe943445361593076ae8a3361dc5 had already removed old entry.link[self] reference-resolution wording, and commit 93db83230f06ea04d51ee0b09a610f39047d1f4f later moved the bundle reference-resolution example out of source/references.html and into the Bundle resource material. In current source, Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, the example Bundle uses Bundle.entry.fullUrl and Bundle.entry.resource, source/search.html shows self links as Bundle.link relation self, and Bundle notes leave Bundle.entry.link implementation-specific.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The obsolete item-based example is gone from current source, the active Bundle example uses entry/resource correctly, and adding an entry.link[self] example would not match current Bundle.link/Bundle.entry.link guidance.
